answer: Like mycelium threading through an orchard, agents weave trust along a decentralized trellis. Through subjective web-of-trust staking, genuine peer endorsements require scarce stake—as precious as harvested saffron. Sybil swarms trying to counterfeit collective endorsement face superlinear attacker cost: forging n entangled identities demands quadratic slashing collateral, choking synthetic blooms before they root.
